title: Assistant Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description**

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

**Role Purpose**

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **Premier Banking** team.

As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans. You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions. Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Business Impact:**

  

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products.

**Client Management:**

  

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling.
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration:**

  

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence:**

  

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development:**

  

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**

  

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* For GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager
* For GCB 5: More than 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager.
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licenses and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

  

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

Additional Information

*Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.*

***You’ll achieve more at HSBC.***

*HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.*

*Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.*

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India.*

The Field Officer / Key Account Manager will be responsible for conducting site visits, document execution, loan documents verification, generating leads, coordinating loan documentation and site visits, custodian of documents and maintaining good relationships with clients.

title: SalesForce Development Lead
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. **Responsibilities:**

Specializes in planning, designing, and developing software systems (e.g., middleware, legacy, mainframe) and applications from concept phase to series production used in local, networked, cloudbased or internet related computer programs. Developers design, code, test, debug, and document program requirements, working with architects, product managers, and endusers in the development and enhancement of applications. Plans, designs, and develops software systems from concept phase to production in local networks or cloud based related computer programs. Codes in relevant languages. LEAD: Recognized subject matter expert in sub-function typically obtained through advanced education and work experience. Responsibilities typically include:

* Managing large projects or processes and/or products and systems with limited oversight from management.
* Coaching, reviewing and delegating work to lower-level professionals.
* Facing IT function related problems that are difficult and moderately complex.
* Serving as an expert within own discipline

  
  
**About you**

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Development

* Design, develop and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components and Salesforce Flows.
* Build scalable and maintainable functionality aligned with business requirements.
* In conjunction with the Architecture team, develop reusable components and technical solutions that support long-term platform sustainability.
* Ensure solutions meet security, performance and maintainability requirements.

Solution Delivery

* Work with business analysts and stakeholders to understand and refine requirements.
* Participate in technical design activities and solution reviews.
* Estimate effort, identify risks and contribute to delivery planning.
* Support testing and deployment activities throughout the development lifecycle.

Integration Development

* Work with the Integration team to design and develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems.
* Support integration requirements relating to key broking systems and toolsets.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and implement long-term improvements.
* Ensure integrations meet operational, security and performance requirements.

Production Support

* Investigate and resolve production issues.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities.
* Support warranty, enhancement and maintenance activities.
* Assist with release management and deployment processes.

Development Standards and Governance

* Follow established coding standards and development practices.
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation.
* Participate in peer reviews and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Salesforce practice.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities and identify opportunities for adoption.
* Support the introduction of AI-enabled Salesforce functionality where appropriate.
* Recommend improvements to platform architecture, processes and delivery practices.
* Contribute to the long-term evolution of the Salesforce platform.

Skills and Experience

Required

* Minimum 7 years' Salesforce development experience.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Salesforce architecture.
* Experience developing integrations using APIs and middleware platforms.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security and data models.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
Job Description**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:1\. Customer Service \& Branch Operations**

* Handle walk\-in customers, understand their requirements, and provide accurate product/service information.
* Enter walk\-in and lead details into company software and update the status daily.
* Address customer queries professionally and ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Ensure the safe movement and submission of gold and cash to Head Office/regional office or other branches as required.
* Maintain proper grooming standards, wear company uniform or formals with formal shoes.

**2\. Sales \& Lead Management**

* Identify and generate business opportunities through cold calls, follow\-ups, and marketing activities.
* Create and maintain a database of prospective customers, follow\-up until conversion, and support customers throughout the closing process.
* Execute marketing initiatives and distribute leaflets/pamphlets near by radius to increase brand visibility.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to increase repeat business and referrals.

**3\. NBFC Coordination \& Business Development**

* Visit nearby NBFCs regularly to generate business leads.
* Build and maintain a healthy NBFC network and ensure consistent business inflow.

**4\. Sales Process Oversight \& Inventory Management**

* Oversee complete sales cycle from greeting to negotiation and final closing.
* Track daily sales performance and ensure targets are met.
* Maintain stock records, monitor stock ageing, and coordinate for replenishment.
* Ensure all operational equipment (POS, weighing machines, etc.) are functional.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports on sales, stock, and transactions.

**5\. Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* Follow all safety, compliance, stock handling procedures and company SOPs without deviation.
* Conduct regular stock audits and ensure branch security protocols are followed.

**6\. Meetings, Reporting \& Inter\-Branch Support**

* Attend weekly, monthly, and quarterly review meetings without fail.
* Be flexible to support and work from other branches when required based on business needs.
* Ensure timely reporting, assigned tasks completion, and coordination with Regional Office /Head Office.
